SELECT followRecord.*, tutorInfo.tutor_name AS tutorName, tutorInfo.domain_type AS domainType, userInfo.level_id AS levelId, levelDef.level_val, levelDef.level_name FROM user_follow_up_record followRecord LEFT JOIN tutor_info tutorInfo ON followRecord.tutor_id = tutorInfo.id LEFT JOIN user_info userInfo ON followRecord.user_id = userInfo.id LEFT JOIN level_def levelDef ON userInfo.level_id = levelDef.id
followRecord.id = #{param.id} and
followRecord.user_id = #{param.userId} and
followRecord.tutor_id = #{param.tutorId} and
followRecord.item_type = #{param.itemType} and
followRecord.follow_status = #{param.followStatus} and
tutorInfo.domain_type = #{param.domainType} and
followRecord.follow_start_time >= #{param.startFollowStartTime} and
followRecord.follow_start_time <= #{param.endFollowStartTime} and
followRecord.followClosingTime >= #{param.startFollowClosingTime} and
followRecord.followClosingTime <= #{param.endFollowClosingTime} and
order by followRecord.follow_start_time desc
